description: Scan Google News and PR wires for funding rounds, executive moves, product launches, and acquisitions at any company domain. Returns deduplicated, dated events in flat Clay-ready JSON. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_name.description: Optional company name hint, used when the domain does not match the brand name, e.g. Deel for deel.com.

domain.description: Company domain to scan, without https or www, e.g. stripe.com.

lookback_days.description: How far back to search, in days. Default 365.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

signal_types.description: Report only these event types. Omit for every type. Narrowing also narrows the search: a funding only run issues one news query instead of four.

name: get_funding_press_signals
title: Get Funding and Press Signals
